findings.body: When a valid plan quotes task IDs with backticks before starting its parts, these timeline headings and SVG names become "A part with no name yet". The child producer at board.py:415–416 looks up the plain task ID in task.rows(), which preserves quoted keys (task.py:63). Unlike the dependency map and existing Parts list, that lookup does not normalize IDs. Multiple active parts therefore receive indistinguishable timeline labels, obscuring which part each recorded duration belongs to. Normalize the child-title lookup and verify the rendered timeline names through the board command.
findings.title: Preserve part names in timelines for backtick task IDs
